entities.name: Marcelo Arévalo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marcelo Arévalo González is a Salvadoran professional tennis player. He is a former world No. 1 in doubles by the ATP, achieved on 11 November 2024 and has a career-high singles ranking of No. 139, attained in April 2018, making him the highest-ranked player, male or female, across both disciplines in Salvadoran tennis history. In December 2024, Arévalo was named El Salvador's Male Sportsman of the Year.
